Context: 3. Review

## 3. Review  
The President can make a review of any order passed earlier, including an order passed in revision, when any new fact or material which has the effect of changing the nature of the case, comes to his notice. However, imposing or enhancing of any penalty can be done only after giving the Government servant concerned a reasonable opportunity of making representation and holding of an inquiry, in cases where one is required to be held under the rules but had not been held. - Rule 29-A.
